title: Comparing Connective Tissue Grafts and Collagen Matrix in Modified Coronally Advanced Tunnel Technique for RT1 Gingival Recession: A Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial
authors: Elbana, A., Saleh, W. & Youssef, J. BMC Oral Health. 2025 Jun 3;25(1):893. doi: 10.1186/s12903-025- 06259-w.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Our study supported the efficacy of the MCAT in isolated gingival recession coverage. The CM may act as an alternative to CTG by increasing the patient's satisfaction and reducing tissue morbidity and surgical time” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
